name: application-nft-card
title: NFT Card
description: NFT marketplace card showing artwork, verified collection identity, token id, title, and a current bid in ETH with a USD equivalent, plus a bid action.
useWhen: Listing NFT or digital-collectible artwork in a marketplace grid.
You need to show collection identity (avatar, name, verified badge) and a crypto-native price pair (ETH + USD) rather than a fiat-only price.
Distinct from Product Card, which shows a star rating and percent-off discount badge rather than collection identity and a bid action.
avoidWhen: Listing conventional retail products — use Product Card instead, which has ratings and discount-badge conventions shoppers expect.
You don't need collection/creator identity or a bid affordance — a plain image card is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The artwork stays a 1:1 square via aspect-square; the price and bid button stay on one row and never wrap independently of each other.
accessibility: The verified-collection checkmark carries an aria-label ("Verified collection") since it conveys meaning through an icon alone.
Artwork alt text is a required prop, encouraging real descriptive text describing the piece rather than a generic filename.

variants.title: NFT Card
variants.description: Square artwork with token id badge, verified collection row, title, ETH/USD current bid, and a Place bid button.
accessibility: Verified badge SVG carries an aria-label rather than relying on color alone to convey verification.

variants.title: NFT Card (Dark)
variants.description: The same card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Verified badge and price contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
